name: Traumatic Resonance
source:
After a difficult and complicated childhood, dragon William finds a bit of breathing room in his life and begins it anew. With a newly acquired group of friends, he goes on a vacation in a relaxing resort, hoping to find some rest after a productive school year.

But as days go by William gets reminded of his past and the things he's been hiding from people closest to him. Will he reconcile with himself and find acceptance within his friends? Or will he snap under pressure from the environment around him?

Especially with a new danger on the horizon, it might prove difficult for him.

[From [url=https://unarthodox.itch.io/traumatic-resonance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在经历了艰难而复杂的童年之后，龙威廉在他的生活中找到了一点喘息的空间，并重新开始。他和一群新认识的朋友一起去一个轻松的度假村度假，希望在富有成效的学年结束后能得到一些休息。

但随着时间的推移，威廉想起了他的过去，以及他一直向最亲近的人隐瞒的事情。他会与自己和解并获得朋友的认可吗？或者他会在周围环境的压力下崩溃吗？

尤其是当新的危险即将出现时，这对他来说可能会很困难。

[来自[url=https://unarthodox.itch.io/traumatic-resonance]Itch.io[/url]]
